conditions.evidence: Pulse oximetry inaccuracies can fail to detect episodes of hidden hypoxemia
conditions.label: hidden hypoxemia

modalities.evidence: it includes 81,797 Intensive Care Unit (ICU) S a O 2 − S p O 2 SaO_2 - SpO_2 pairs

output.population: Intensive Care Unit patients with paired SaO2-SpO2 measurements derived from MIMIC-IV v2.2
output.summary: Paired arterial and peripheral oxygen saturation measurements derived from an intensive care database, intended for building pulse oximetry correction models addressing measurement bias across skin tones.
